svg.title: Booking card: make a translucent information surface opaque
svg.desc: Only booking-surface opacity changes 0.66→1. The cream rectangle stays at x150/y405/310×280. Photograph bytes/crop, all text, button, spacing, phone stage and lighting stay fixed. The photograph remains visible above and around the surface. This is a static fictional booking page. Fictional example. Reused generated photographic assets and native composition.
svg.text: BEFORE · Desk details show through the card
AFTER · Facts sit on an opaque surface
Only the declared background opacity changes. Foreground content, type, image crop and presentation stay fixed.
